name: MedTech Index
scope: A modern polyhierarchy of medical science disciplines
description: The complete local index. It treats anatomy, disease, method, population, care setting, and translational stage as intersecting facets rather than forcing every field into one tree.

name: Medical Subject Headings (MeSH)
description: A MedTech Index crosswalk grouped by the most relevant high-level MeSH tree. MeSH is broader than disciplines and also organizes anatomy, diseases, processes, techniques, and health care.

name: ACGME Specialties
steward: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education
description: Clinical fields in the MedTech Index that map to an ACGME specialty umbrella. This lens describes accredited professional training, not the whole of medical research.

name: OECD Fields of R&D (FORD)
steward: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
description: The complete MedTech Index grouped into FORD's five medical and health science divisions. This lens is useful for portfolios and reporting, but intentionally coarse.

name: NIH RCDC
scope: Funded research, condition, and disease categories
description: Research areas and disease domains in the MedTech Index that align with the overlapping topic model used for NIH categorical spending. It is a portfolio lens, not a discipline hierarchy.

name: WHO-FIC: ICD, ICF & ICHI
scope: Diseases, functioning, disability, and health interventions
description: MedTech fields connected to ICD (diseases and health conditions), ICF (functioning and disability), or ICHI (interventions). These systems classify the objects and activities of medicine rather than scientific disciplines themselves.
